g.text: GPU passes in one frame: submission order on the graphics queue
All three need initialized field lighting.
SourceUpload also needs a pending source update.
field copy · dirty cascades · ordinary cascades
and when MSAA draws the background directly.
The particle chain needs GPU particles.
Pack also needs changed source, terrain or metadata.
Liquid and solid passes need the matching material.
fullscreen composite in the surface scene pass
orange = compute pass · purple = render pass
grey = offscreen branch or submit/present boundary
Rows are pass boundaries; rows between the scene pass begin/end are its draws.
A pass may contain several dispatches.
Offscreen is requested by retro, palette, HDR, temporal or native samples;
the native path skips that branch.
One graphics queue: encode order is execution order.
